verdict.rationale: Published deadline and fee schedules are a fair question for an IP office like INPI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only titles of filing-procedure pages (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau, provisional patent application) and no snippet showing filing deadlines, late-payment penalties, surcharges or interest schedules with exact figures. With no evidence for the capability, the verdict is none rather than na.
